discord.text:
**Newsroom brief: SINGLE-SOURCE REPORT - REUTERS | Reuters: Tesla's cash-flow surprise leaves the operating question open [Source 2026-10-21]**

Reuters reports positive Tesla free cash flow as capex misses estimates.

**Context:** The serious countercase is that operating cash may also have strengthened.

Read the article: https://capitalchronicle.substack.com/p/pending-publication-44561321bc94626d

Source date: 2026-10-21. Interpretation remains analysis.
